title: fix(ui): remove retired quota reset formatter
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the Control UI unused-export finding for `formatQuotaReset` in scheduled CI run [40121287574](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/40121287574).

## User Impact

No user-visible change. Quota reset presentation continues to use the composer's current formatter.

## Why This Change Was Made

#179225 replaced the final production caller with the composer's absolute-time formatter. Remove the retired relative-time helper and its test-only callers while retaining quota-grouping and composer behavior coverage.

## Evidence

- Focused `provider-quota-summary.test.ts` and `chat-composer-context.test.ts`: 14 tests passed.
- UI typecheck, focused lint, formatting, and `git diff --check`: passed.
- Independent review: no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- Full dependency, unused-file, and all three unused-export scan phases completed. They remain red for unrelated findings, while `formatQuotaReset` is no longer reported. The remaining UI findings are `emptyCronList` in `session-dashboard.test-support.ts` (owned by #180697) and `model` in the untouched `test-helpers/model-providers.ts`; no Android findings were reported.
